_comment: Cross-port YAML divergences ledgered as known-gap (the runner treats listed fixtures as passing). error-yaml-coerced-hex-in-string: YamlDotNet does not coerce `0xFF` to a number under its default core schema — it stays a string — so the D2 coercion-guard never fires for hex literals in a string-typed attr context. TS yaml, PyYAML, SnakeYAML all coerce `0xFF` to int 255, triggering ERR_YAML_COERCION on a string-typed `@column`. Cross-port reference TS produces one ERR_YAML_COERCION; C# produces zero errors. (The other YAML 1.2 coercion guards — null, bool-in-string, bool-in-stringarray — match TS.)
